title: The Valley That Woke Up
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of the brave start, and tonight Ezekiel is told to speak to a valley of dry bones that looks past saving. Speaking anyway, and watering a cup of dirt for days with nothing to show, is exactly Beau’s kind of courage.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because doing the right thing when it looks impossible takes real faith. In Beau’s world today: Beau planted one seed in a paper cup, and nothing happened for days. He kept watering it, even when his sister said it was done for. On Friday a green curl pushed up through the dirt. Just like Ezekiel speaking Heavenly Father’s words in the still valley, Beau learned that Heavenly Father brings life where we cannot see it yet.
